authorization: Offline evaluation of completed target score arrays may read target Label and Attack only after both committed transfer manifests validate. No labels enter fitting, preprocessing, calibration, normalization, score transformation, or transfer scoring.
primary_operational_endpoint: attack-miss capture at exactly floor(0.05*N) review rows
secondary_endpoints: family-level attack-miss AUPRC where a family is locally identifiable
selective residual error and miss rates
conformal coverage only where set membership can be reconstructed from frozen outputs

scores.confidence: larger means more review-worthy; use saved float32 as-is
scores.random_forest_disagreement: larger means more review-worthy; use saved float32 as-is
scores.feature_space_distance: larger means more review-worthy; use saved float32 as-is
scores.split_conformal: larger means more review-worthy; use saved float32 as-is
scores.isolation_forest: larger means more review-worthy; use saved float32 as-is

ranking.ties: stable ascending input row offset for capture; AP groups equal scores and is tie-invariant
ranking.nonfinite: fail analysis; no imputation or dropping

estimands.primary_unit: matched seed within direction; do not pool rows across seeds as independent
summary: bootstrap percentile interval over 10 matched seeds
estimands.inference_caution: 10 seeds support descriptive paired uncertainty; avoid overstating p-values

families.unseen_claim: only supported cross-domain family IDs can support seen/unseen classification; registry withholds unsupported mappings, so do not infer unseen from raw string differences

conformal.saved_signal: (prediction_set_size-1); larger means more deserving of review
conformal.coverage: must reconstruct frozen prediction set using source quantile and target calibrated probability; do not recalibrate

integrity.manifests: validate both locks before target labels are yielded

computation_separation: This specification precedes label evaluation; existing transfer outputs remain immutable.
